load-panel.$description: LoadPanel: a loading layer over a container or the page, a pane with the indicator, the message and a Cancel button.

padding.$description: The least space between the pane and the edge of what it covers.

gap.$description: Between the indicator, the message and the button.

cancel.$description: The Cancel button in the pane.

shade.$description: The layer over what is covered: its fill when `shade` is on (`shaded`), else clear.

pane.$description: The box behind the indicator and the message, drawn when `showPane` is on (`shown`).
